narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Flask of Chromatic Resistance, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.

tooltip: Use: Increases your resistance to all schools of magic by 25 for 2 hr. You can only have the effect of one flask at a time. This effect persists through death and stacks with all other resistance spells and items. (3 Sec Cooldown)
